sentences.text:
Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

The petitioners have challenged the order dated 03.05.2024 passed in connection with Agarpada P.S. Case No.10 of 2015 corresponding to Special Case No.55 of 2017 for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 363/ 294/ 506/ 366/
376(2)(n) of the IPC r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of the learned Ad hoc Special Judge, (POCSO), Bhadrak, by which the N.B.W. has been issued against them.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners were admitted to bail on 04.10.2021, however, they could not appear before the learned Court below leading to issuance of the N.B.W. against them on 03.05.2024.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners, on instruction, submits that, the petitioners would surrender/appear before the learned Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and seek remedy available to them under law.

4. On the basis of the aforementioned facts and submissions made at the Bar, the order dated 03.05.2024 passed in connection with Agarpada P.S. Case No.10 of 2015 corresponding to Special Case No.55 of 2017, pending in the Court of the learned Ad hoc Special Judge, (POCSO), Bhadrak, is set aside, subject to the petitioners surrendering before the Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and depositing cost of Rs.500/- (Rupees five hundred) each with District Bar Association, Bhadrak.
Liberty is granted to the petitioners to avail remedy under law after surrendering as per the undertaking.
